globalFeatures.title: Every MonkGames title ships with the same reliability, fairness, and flexibility under the hood.

items.title: Provably Fair by Default
items.description: All engines integrate with OpenRNG, giving you transparent, auditable results with clear round histories and exportable proofs for regulators.

items.title: Theme-Ready Architecture
items.description: Visuals, audio, UX flow, and copy are separated from core logic. That means you can apply marketplace themes or commission one-of-one experiences without touching the engine.

items.title: Built for Operators & Builders
items.description: API-driven integration, SDKs for common stacks, and a roadmap that keeps operators, aggregators, and independent builders in mind.

items.question: Are MonkGames titles plug-and-play?
items.answer: We provide engine-level integrations via API and SDKs. Frontend components can be adapted to your existing stack, and themes are layered on top of the same core engine logic.

items.question: How do you handle fairness and RNG?
items.answer: All sensitive outcomes are generated via OpenRNG, our open-source, provably fair RNG stack. Operators and regulators can audit seeds, outcomes, and round histories independently.

items.question: Can we deploy multiple themes on the same game?
items.answer: Yes. A single engine instance can power multiple themes — for different brands, markets, or seasonal campaigns — without duplicating the underlying logic.

items.question: Do you support both web2 and web3 flows?
items.answer: Yes. Engines can run in traditional account-based environments, wallet-based web3 flows, or hybrids, depending on your jurisdiction and platform.
